An '''iron sword''' is the [[Iron equipment|iron]] [[Weapons#Sword|sword]], crafted from [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. It deals 6 damage at an attack speed of 1.6 and has 500 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/iron_sword.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which sets the stats shown in the infobox.

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

The iron swords in [[Abbey]] barracks and tower chests are a different variant: they carry [[Anemos]] I and set only an attack damage modifier, so they have no attack cooldown (attack speed 4) even though their tooltip shows 1.6.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/abbey/barracks.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Iron Ingot|iron ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/iron_ingot_from_blasting_iron_materials.json}}</ref>
